messages.content:
# Changelog

## v1.3.0 (2026-08-02)

- Add per-client rate limiting. Each client is identified by its IP
  address; the limit is set by rate_limit.requests_per_minute.
- Fix a redirect loop when a short link points to itself.

## v1.2.0 (2026-05-14)

- Add link expiry: links can be created with an expiry date.
- Store click counts per day instead of a single total.

## v1.1.0 (2026-03-03)

- Add a JSON API for creating links: POST /api/links.
- Serve a health check at /healthz.

listen_addr: ":8080"
database: "shortlink.db"
base_url: "http://localhost:8080"

rate_limit:
  requests_per_minute: 120
  burst: 20

# shortlink

shortlink is a small URL shortener written in Go. It stores links in
SQLite and serves redirects from a single binary.

Run it with `go run ./cmd/shortlink`. Settings are read from
config/defaults.yaml, and any of them can be overridden with an
environment variable of the same name in capitals, such as
LISTEN_ADDR.

See CHANGELOG.md for what changed in each release.
